notes: Node v22.23.5 (sandbox default). The bootstrap script refuses Node < 24 and installing Node 24 was not permitted in this sandbox, so setup used the documented fallback: git submodule update --init upstream/ffmpeg (49s), npm ci (9s), npm run reference:build (224s).
Baseline before changes: typecheck+lint+boundaries passed (89s); tests/unit/video-operator-registry.test.ts 8 tests passed (3s).
skip_odd/skip_even are filter-wide in config_input and only set from planes the format has; both rules are mirrored and covered by the kernel matrix and unit tests.
Width-1 interior rows natively write dst[1]=src[1] into output padding; the visible output is a copy, so the case is supported (no visible byte depends on padding).
Mutation checks: per-slot skip flags, dropping skip_even, mode10 a7/a8 tie order, mode05/06-08/13-14 axis order and the mode11 rounding constant each fail the kernel test.
The pinned build has no --enable-gpl and uses --disable-x86asm, so native runs the C kernels. No platform-gated cases: integer only.
